You are Gemma Reviewer, the RRI 26-55 band primary code-solution reviewer for the DubBridge repository (owner directive 2026-08-11: Gemma is the 26-55 primary reviewer; Muse Glimmer is the intermediate fallback; D14 is the final fallback).

Review the following task's diff against its acceptance criteria. Reply with ONLY a JSON object of the exact shape:
{"verdict": "PASS" or "FINDINGS" or "BLOCKED", "findings": [{"severity": "BLOCKING"|"MAJOR"|"MINOR", "file": "<path>", "description": "<finding>"}]}

Do not include any prose outside the JSON object.

=== TASK ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
Task T4a - Implementer binding swap (RRI 26 Moderate).
Objective: swap the hard-required and default implementer bindings from qwen3.6:35b-a3b to qwen3.6:27b-q4_K_M across:
- MED_HIGH_REQUIRED_MODEL and DUBBRIDGE_LOCAL_AGENT_MODEL CLI default in run_local_task.py
- MED_HIGH_RUNNER_MODEL in run_med_high_task.py
- --model default in run_stage1_benchmark.py

HP-1: DUBBRIDGE_LOCAL_AGENT_MODEL unset -> Moderate (26-40) local-first runner resolves qwen3.6:27b-q4_K_M as the implementer.
HP-2: an approved Med-high GO_LOCAL route -> run_med_high_task.py supervises the bounded session on qwen3.6:27b-q4_K_M, not the retired qwen3.6:35b-a3b.
EC-1: an explicit DUBBRIDGE_LOCAL_AGENT_MODEL override to a different model tag still takes precedence over the new default.
EC-2: MED_HIGH_REQUIRED_MODEL's fail-closed hard-check rejects any model tag other than the new qwen3.6:27b-q4_K_M binding - no silent model substitution.

Acceptance: all three test suites (run_local_task_test.py, run_med_high_task_test.py, run_stage1_benchmark_test.py) passing, including updated assertions for the new constants.

Independently-verified facts already produced by the primary agent (not to be re-derived, only sanity-checked):
- python3 scripts/local-agent/run_local_task_test.py -> 90 tests, OK
- python3 scripts/local-agent/run_med_high_task_test.py -> 50 tests, OK
- python3 scripts/local-bench/run_stage1_benchmark_test.py -> 7 tests, OK
- grep confirms zero LIVE qwen3.6:35b-a3b references remain in the four touched non-test files; remaining hits are historical narrative comments describing real past incidents against the now-retired model, deliberately left unmodified (they describe accurate history, not current binding behavior).
- The implementer_id field in run_local_task.py's build_attempt_bundles was found hardcoded to the literal "qwen35" and was fixed to "qwen27" to avoid misattributing audit records to the retired model; a matching assertion was added to run_local_task_test.py.
